goal: Reproduce Windows target, native authority, filesystem and channel gaps.

goal: Establish separate PE lineages, native opaque custody and one atomic filesystem transaction port.
description: Scope: Windows Architecture.md, builders/verifiers, Hello/DPAPI adapter, installer and shared filesystem port. Context: target aliases and per-feature unsafe journals undermine evidence. Target: x64/arm64 lineages and native infrastructure consume parent contracts through typed ports. Design Considerations: no-follow containment, private durable journal and atomic commit. Design Value: one security invariant protects install, export and skills. Constraints & Risks: remove copy-over-link and duplicated recovery paths completely.

acceptance_criteria.text: Architecture names one owner and failure state for each architecture, custody, state, channel and protocol receipt.

goal: Build and verify independent native Windows x64 and arm64 artifacts.

Design Value: removes relabeling and host projection. Constraints & Risks: each target stays unsupported until run on its native builder.

acceptance_criteria.text: Native clean builds verify PE architecture, DLLs, CLI, profile, source and digest separately for x64 and arm64 and reject cross-target substitution.

goal: Prove Windows Hello or DPAPI opaque custody and real deletion.
description: Scope: native secret adapter, authorization session, process/bridge boundary, delete and capability facts. Context: no real native flow is proven and generic secret leakage must stay closed. Target: one user-authorized workflow uses opaque handles or explicit memory-only custody. Design Considerations: typed session expiry and hostile argument/log scans. Design Value: makes endpoint authority native and inspectable. Constraints & Risks: background work cannot prompt; no plaintext/file fallback.

acceptance_criteria.text: Native cases cover success, denial, cancellation, background, expiry, delete and memory-only while hostile scans find no secret-bearing argument, bridge or log.

goal: Make Windows install, update, export and skill state containment-safe and crash-consistent.
description: Scope: shared file security, Windows reparse handling, installer, export, skill rollback and journal recovery. Context: rename fallback, unchecked snapshot paths and ordinary journals can escape or corrupt state. Target: one no-follow transaction port enforces roots, ownership, private durable journal, atomic commit and rollback. Design Considerations: native handles and failure injection. Design Value: replaces multiple unsafe recovery implementations. Constraints & Risks: remove wildcard cleanup and copy fallback after current authority lands.

acceptance_criteria.text: Native hostile tests cover traversal, reparse/symlink race, locked files, interruption and cross-volume simulation with containment and rollback.
